data.title: Swiss Style
data.tagline: Build clarity through grid, typography, and objective visual order
data.description: Swiss Style uses a strong grid, sans-serif type, asymmetric composition, and disciplined spacing to make information easy to scan. Its clean appearance comes from exact relationships, not from centering everything or removing all personality.

use: Information-rich page that needs strict order
avoid: Place every element in the center
Use a grid without meaningful hierarchy
Make type so rigid that long content becomes difficult to read
Add decoration that fights the information structure

data.agentPrompt: Swiss International Style, strict grid, huge left-aligned sans-serif headline, black and white with one red accent, extreme type-scale contrast, no decorative shadows, generous structured whitespace
